notes: Fastned vehicle page chart data (the page embeds a per-percent kW series); Fastned says the curve shows the car on its network with the battery in optimal conditions (around 30 °C), and a colder or warmer battery can charge much slower. Sampled every 5 % plus the first, last and peak points. Fastned does not state the session count, ambient temperature or preconditioning. Fastned page for the 87 kWh ARIYA (2022+). The series starts at 7 % with 144-149 kW for 7-15 % before stepping down to 129-131 kW at 16 %; the 7-15 % section is left out here because it is above the 130 kW Nissan peak (the linter allows 5 % over) and nothing else supports it. Recorded series therefore begins at 16 %. Fastned's own series peaks at 148.7 kW at 15 %, above Nissan's 130 kW rating, so points below 16 % are left out.
